Use case: ui-mockup. Create a Chinese editorial demonstration illustration for an article about everyday AI use. Header "把问题问具体". User message exact: "手冲咖啡总是偏酸，可能是什么原因？". Assistant short reply shown as 3 generous numbered cards: "1 先看豆子与烘焙度" / "2 再看研磨、水温和萃取" / "3 每次只调整一个变量". Follow-up user bubble: "我用浅烘豆，水温90℃，先改哪一项？". Small unobtrusive but readable label "AI生成·对话示意". Visual conveys asking with context and following up, tasteful minimal coffee dripper paper-cut in corner outside window. No DeepSeek/ChatGPT logos, no fabricated citations, no time saved claims. This is a clearly labeled conceptual demo, not an actual historical chat screenshot. All labels exact, no other small gibberish text.
